premise: a scientific preprint, printed first, then annotated by hand
about: The colophon: what this thing is set in, as data. A book's colophon names its faces, its paper and its inks. This one does the same for the design language, machine-readably, and it is vendored beside the tokens so any tool or agent can learn what never changes without the system repository present. tools/check verifies every value here against the token CSS, so this file cannot quietly drift from what actually ships.
read-first: AGENTS.md beside this file. In the system repository, readme.md and guidelines/invariants.md.

namespace.rule: a site's own variables live under the site's own prefix, and a --pp-* the system does not define is squatting

invariants.note: The identity. Restate one of these in a site's own layer and the family stops being a family. Everything not listed here, and not a law, is the site's own call.
invariants.plates: pressed with the page: full strength, never translucent, no fixed meaning, never a fill behind white, and below 18px they hand over to their -text companions
invariants.markers: added afterwards: translucent, and only ever a field behind type, via .mk--citron, .mk--pink, .mk--cyan or data-pp-mark, never a raw background and never a text colour

math.optional: a site with no mathematics omits it by declaring so in its tokens/fonts.css

faces.rule: three faces, three jobs. A face never takes a job that belongs to another.

radius.rule: the cut scale: trimmed rather than moulded, rising with control size

styles.dashed: a boundary the reader may cross

targets-px.touch: compact meets the floor where hover is none

mode.rule: one dark mode for every surface, set on the root element before first paint, never forked per site or per page

motion.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion sets every duration token to 0ms
motion.rule: everything else is still, including on load and on scroll

interdictions: soft glow shadows: a cast is a hard offset (5px 5px 0) or there is no cast
a plate as running text below 18px
a plate as a fill behind white

assets.angle-law: 16-unit grid, 1.35px stroke, square caps, horizontal, vertical and 45 degrees only, at most one filled square per glyph

surfaces.rule: load one, never both: .btn, .note, .rail and .head__row name different objects in the two sheets

laws.law-00: two licensed breaches in one view cancel each other, so budget one per view
laws.marker: a breach is declared in place, in a comment: breach(NN): what, and why. An undeclared deviation is drift. See guidelines/transfer.md.

table.breach: one element borrows a radius from another scale
one line leaves it, in size, weight or face
one element crosses or bleeds past it
one element casts a hard offset instead of a soft one
one element claims a plate semantically
one element rotates, up to 1.5 degrees
one section takes twice the air, or half

moves.vendor: system to site, by tools/sync, into assets/preprint/, committed
moves.promote: site to system, when a second surface wants the thing, by changing the system at its source
moves.quote: site to site, never: route it through the system or leave it home

checks.conformance: tools/conformance.js reads a site's own layer and fails on restated invariants, a squatted namespace, and survivors of earlier systems
checks.system: tools/check reads the system repository and fails when this file, the docs and the disk disagree
